purpose: Retrospective cross-station validation, not archived forecast verification
vertical_interpolation: linear, checked against returned depth metadata
temporal_alignment: native model timestamps only, nearest observation within 5 min; source observation and model validity both <= t - lag; no temporal model interpolation. With 3-hour model output, 60 and 180 min can select the same source residual.
correction: target model(t) + alpha * (other observation(s) - other model(s)); s <= t - lag. Never use the target station in its own dynamic correction.
alpha_selection: lowest pooled MAE on development period only; smallest alpha wins ties; one shared alpha for both stations
baseline: raw model on identical paired timestamps; also compare a constant per-target bias fitted on development only
uncertainty: paired bootstrap of UTC days, both stations sampled together, 10000 replicates, seed 20261103; conditional on the development-selected alpha
limits: Historical publication times of sensor observations and original model runs are unavailable. Availability lag is a scenario, not a verified SLA.
The two points validate a transfer between these stations only, not an IDW field across the lake.
Independent from Openwind fitting does not establish independence from Eawag model calibration or data assimilation.
No claim about other seasons, other lakes or multi-day forecast improvement.
